# Women's Running

> > The world's largest women-specific running magazine, offering training plans, nutrition guidance, injury prevention, and cultural perspectives for runners of all levels.

Women's Running covers everything from beginner guides and marathon training to athlete profiles, Olympic history, and body positivity in sport. Founded to serve female runners, the publication features expert coaches like Hillary Kigar and covers major events including the Boston Marathon and U.S. Olympic Trials.

## Key Topics

- Marathon training and racing
- Beginner running guides
- 5K and half-marathon training
- Running form and technique
- Injury prevention and recovery
- Women's running culture and history
- Menopause and female athlete health
- Speed training and PRs
- Running nutrition
- Mental health and body positivity
- Trail and ultramarathon running
- Boston Marathon
- Olympic track and field
- Running shoes and gear

## Essential Training Guides

- [How to Start Running - Women's Running](https://womensrunning.com/collection/how-to-start-running): Complete beginner's guide with 6-week plan to start running right
- [Marathon Central - Women's Running](https://womensrunning.com/collection/marathon-central): Comprehensive marathon training hub with plans, race strategies, and tips
- [The Beginner's Guide To Perfect Running Form](https://womensrunning.com/training/beginner/beginners-guide-running-form): Step-by-step body check guide for proper running technique by Hillary Kigar
- [16-Week 50K Training Plan | The Best Beginner 50K Training Plan](https://womensrunning.com/training/trail/your-first-time-50k-training-plan): David Roche's 16-week plan for first-time 50K ultramarathon runners
- [How to Start Running: 10 Top Questions, Answered - Women's Running](https://womensrunning.com/training/beginner/how-to-start-running-questions-answered): Top 10 beginner questions answered on starting a running routine safely
- [How to Run a Faster Mile: A One-Mile Training Plan for PRs](https://womensrunning.com/training/road/how-to-run-faster-mile-training-plan): 8-week speed training plan for mile PRs with interval workouts
- [The Slow Runner's Guide To A Fast(er) 5K | How to Set a PR](https://womensrunning.com/training/road/guide-faster-5k): Meredith Atwood's three keys to breaking a 5K PR for slower runners

## Form, Technique & Performance

- [Correct Your Running Form With This Total Body Reset](https://womensrunning.com/training/good-running-form): Head-to-toe form correction guide for better running economy
- [Talking While Running: Our Coach's Advice For Distance Pacing](https://womensrunning.com/training/road/distance-pacing-talking): Hillary Kigar's talk test method for proper long run pacing
- [The Training You May Be Neglecting But Shouldn't](https://womensrunning.com/training/the-training-you-may-be-neglecting-but-shouldnt): Speed training tips from Nike coach Joe Holder for faster running
- [Running Acronyms To Know—Including A Little LSD](https://womensrunning.com/culture/running-acronyms-know): Handy guide to common running acronyms and training terminology

## Injury Prevention & Recovery

- [Should You Use Cold or Heat for Recovery? - Women's Running](https://womensrunning.com/training/recovery/should-you-use-cold-or-heat-for-recovery): Guide to treating DOMS with cold/heat therapy and KT Tape application
- [Here's How To Stop Persisting Pain In Your Low Back](https://womensrunning.com/health/stop-persisting-low-back-pain): Physical therapy fixes for low back pain from pelvic and core issues
- [Answers To Five Common Post-Run Questions](https://womensrunning.com/training/answers-to-five-common-post-run-questions): Post-race recovery tips from NYC trainer Elizabeth Corkum
- [What's Your Body Telling You? Here's How To Listen.](https://womensrunning.com/health/how-to-listen-to-your-body): Female athlete body signals guide covering RED-S and menstrual health

## Running Culture & Athlete Stories

- [Florence Griffith Joyner: The Life, Speed, and Style of Flo-Jo](https://womensrunning.com/culture/people/florence-griffith-joyner-biography): Biography of Flo-Jo, fastest woman ever with unmatched 100m/200m records
- [Olympics History: How Women's Track and Field Made it to the Olympics](https://womensrunning.com/events/olympics/womens-track-and-field-olympics-history): Alice Milliat and Women's Olympic Games fight for inclusion in 1920s
- [Chasing Goodness: Lauren Fleshman's 'Good for a Girl'](https://womensrunning.com/culture/people/lauren-fleshmans-good-for-girl): Review of Lauren Fleshman's memoir on running in a male-built system
- [We Need to Change How Kids (and Adults) Learn About Weight](https://womensrunning.com/culture/we-need-to-change-how-kids-and-adults-learn-about-weight): Virginia Sole-Smith interview on 'Fat Talk' and anti-fat bias in sports
- [Why Do People Run: What Being a Runner Means to You](https://womensrunning.com/culture/what-being-a-runner-means-to-you): Nine women share perspectives on runner identity and motivation
- [I Needed Help to Overcome a Running Addiction](https://womensrunning.com/health/wellness/i-needed-help-to-overcome-a-running-addiction): Hannah Hartzell's recovery story from exercise addiction at Butler University

## Race Coverage & Events

- [47 Fun Facts About The 47th Annual TCS NYC Marathon](https://womensrunning.com/culture/47-fun-facts-about-the-tcs-nyc-marathon): 47 facts about NYC Marathon featuring Meb Keflezighi and course records
- [Fun Facts About The Rock 'N' Roll Las Vegas Weekend](https://womensrunning.com/events/fun-facts-about-the-rock-n-roll-las-vegas-weekend): Behind-the-scenes facts about Rock 'n' Roll Las Vegas race weekend
- [A Beginner's Guide To Running Back-To-Back Marathons](https://womensrunning.com/training/beginner/running-back-to-back-marathons): Training and recovery strategies for consecutive marathon racing
